Yah baat isliye sahi hai ki jiski aay par kar lagta hai wahi ushe bharta hai; isliye kamane wale se kar katkar seedha sarkar ke paas pahunchta hai, jabki customs, GST tatha utpadan shulk jaise kar maal tatha seva ke daam mein judkar aage ke grahak par pade jaate hain. Customs duty, GST tatha excise duty wale vikalp gair-pratyaksh kar hain, isliye inmein se koi is pehchaan ka nahi.Exam point: pratyaksh kar ka bojh hataya nahi ja sakta - aay kar isi tarah ka kar hai.

qe: The mechanism used by RBI to provide temporary loans to the government to meet mismatches in receipts and payments is called:
qh: प्राप्तियों और भुगतानों में बेमेल को पूरा करने के लिए सरकार को अस्थायी ऋण प्रदान करने के लिए आरबीआई द्वारा उपयोग किए जाने वाले तंत्र को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Jab sarkar ki praptiyan tatha bhugtan mein asaantulan ho, tab RBI jo chhote samay ka karz deta hai use Ways and Means Advances (WMA) kehte hain, isliye chauthe vikalp ka naam sahi hai. Yah chhota udhar isliye milta hai ki mahine ke shuru mein kharch to hona hai par kar tatha karz ki aay baad mein aati hai; isliye kuch dino ke liye paisa udhar milta hai tatha aay aate hi ise chuka diya jaata hai. SLR, reverse repo tatha khuli bazaar wali karyavahi RBI ke anya hathiyar hain, isliye inmein se koi is kaam ka sahi naam nahi hai.Exam point: WMA sarkar ke achanak paise ki kami ko poora karne ka chhota udhar hai - ise tay samay mein chukana zaroori hota hai.

qe: What is the 'Cascading Effect' of taxes?
qh: करो का 'कैस्केडिंग प्रभाव' (Cascading Effect) क्या है?
o: Tax on tax (multiple taxation on the same product at different stages)
e: Jab ek hi maal par har charan mein phir se kar lagta hai tatha puraana kar bhi naye kar mein joda jaata hai, use cascading effect kehte hain, isliye doosra vikalp sahi bayaan hai. Yah asar isliye nuksandeh hai ki maal ka daam har mod par badhta jaata hai tatha antim grahak ko zyada paisa dena padta hai; isliye pehle excise tatha VAT ka kar bhi karobar wale ke kharche mein jodkar agle kar mein shamil ho jaata tha, isliye GST aane se yah jodi toot gayi. Keval majedaar cheezon par kar, pardeshiyon ka kar tatha chhoot wale vikalp is shabd se alag hain, isliye inmein se koi is baat ko nahi samjhata.Exam point: cascading effect kar par kar ko kehte hain - isi ko rokne ke liye GST laaya gaya.

qe: GST (Goods and Services Tax) was introduced to replace which type of taxes?
qh: GST (वस्तु एवं सेवा कर) को किस प्रकार के करों को बदलने के लिए पेश किया गया था?
o: Multiple Indirect Taxes (like Excise, VAT, Service tax)
e: GST un kaee gair-pratyaksh karon ki jagah laaya gaya jaise excise, VAT tatha seva kar, isliye teesra vikalp sahi thaharta hai. Yah badlav isliye kiya gaya ki pehle har rajya ke alag-alag kar tatha seema par lagna wale shulk se maal mahanga hota tha; isliye ek hi kar tatha ek hi bazaar banane se saaman sasta hota hai tatha karobar aasan hota hai. Keval aay kar, keval sampatti kar tatha keval videshi aayat shulk wale vikalp is badlav ke sahi dohrare nahi hain, isliye inmein se koi is badlav ka hissa nahi.Exam point: GST ne ek se zyada gair-pratyaksh kar hataye - yahi ek desh ek kar ka aadhar hai.

qe: Which body is responsible for making decisions on GST rates and exemptions in India?
qh: भारत में जीएसटी दरों और छूट पर निर्णय लेने के लिए कौन सी संस्था जिम्मेदार है?
e: GST ki dar tatha chhoot par faisla GST Council leti hai, isliye teesra naam sahi thaharta hai. Yah sanstha isliye banayi gayi ki kendra tatha rajya dono ko mil kar kar ki dar tay karni hai, warna ek taraf ko nuksan hota; isliye vitta mantri uski adhyakshat karte hain tatha sabhi rajyon ke vitta mantri uske sadasya hote hain, tatha uski salah manna dono pakshon ko aasan lagta hai. Vitt aayog, uchchatam nyayalaya tatha RBI is faisle ke laayak nahi hain, isliye inmein se koi yahan bal nahi rakhta.Exam point: GST Council hi GST ki dar tatha chhoot tay karti hai - yahi kendra-rajya ke saanjhe faisle ka manch hai.

qe: What is the primary characteristic of a 'Progressive Tax' system?
qh: 'प्रगतिशील कर' (Progressive Tax) प्रणाली की प्राथमिक विशेषता क्या है?
o: Tax rate increases as income increases
Tax rate decreases as income increases
Tax rate remains the same for everyone
e: Pragatisheel kar yaani Progressive Tax vyavastha ki pehchaan yah hai ki aay badhne par kar ki dar bhi badhti hai, isliye pehla vikalp sahi pehchaan hai. Yah dhaarna isliye apnayi jaati hai ki kamane wale par bojh kam tatha zyada kamane wale par bojh zyada pade; isliye jo adhik aay kamata hai uski uchh shreni mein zyada pratishat kar diya jaata hai, aur yahi dhaarna sampatti ke anthar ko kam karne mein madad karti hai. Keval gareeb kar bharein, aay badhne par kar ghatna tatha sab par ek hi dar wale vikalp is dhaarna ke sahi roop nahi hain, isliye inmein se koi yahan ginti mein nahi aata.Exam point: pragatisheel kar mein aay ke saath dar badhti hai - isliye yah anthar kam karne ka upay hai.

qe: What happens to 'Exports' under the GST regime in India?
qh: भारत में जीएसटी शासन के तहत 'निर्यात' (Exports) का क्या होता है?
e: GST vyavastha mein niryat yaani Exports par kar shunya dar se lagta hai, isliye pehla vikalp sahi sthiti batata hai. Iska matlab isliye yah hai ki niryat par jo kar diya gaya ho wo wapas milta hai tatha bahar bheje jaane wale saaman par koi chhipa kar nahi rehta; isliye bharat ka maal videshi bazaar mein sasta tatha akarshak banta hai tatha niryatkar ka paisa bhi nahi rukta. Atthais pratishat wala kar, niryat par rok tatha keval kheti niryat par kar wale vikalp is niyam ke sahi nahi hain, isliye inmein se koi is niyam ke andar nahi.Exam point: niryat ko GST mein shunya dar wala mana jaata hai - isliye uska kar wapas milta hai tatha niryat badhti hai.

qe: The concept of 'Widening the Tax Base' refers to:
qh: 'कर आधार को व्यापक बनाने' (Widening the Tax Base) की अवधारणा का तात्पर्य है:
o: Increasing the tax rate for existing taxpayers
Increasing the number of people who fall under the tax net
e: Kar aadhar badhana yaani Widening the Tax Base ka matlab hai kar ki jadd mein zyada logon tatha kaam-dhandhon ko laana, isliye chauthe vikalp wala vichaar sahi hai. Yah koshish isliye hoti hai ki dar badhane ke bina bhi sarkar ki vasooli badhe; isliye naye karobar ka panjikaran, aay kar ke daayare ka failav tatha chhoti dukaanon ko jodne se aay ka zariya chaura hota hai, tatha aam aadmi par bojh nahi padta. Gair-pratyaksh kar hata dena, maujood kar dene walon par dar badhana tatha vasooli ghatana wale vikalp is soch ke viprit hain, isliye inmein se koi is soch ke barabar nahi.Exam point: kar aadhar failane ka matlab zyada logon ko kar ke daayare mein laana hai - isse bina dar badhaye vasooli badhti hai.

qe: What significant change was made to the Rail Budget in 2017?
qh: 2017 में रेल बजट में क्या महत्वपूर्ण बदलाव किया गया था?
o: The Rail Budget was merged with the Union Budget
The Rail Budget was completely abolished
Railway fares were made free for everyone
e: 2017 mein rail budget ko kendra ke aam budget mein mila diya gaya tha, isliye pehla vikalp sahi badlav hai. Yah badlav isliye kiya gaya ki rail ka kharch tatha aay kendra ke baaki kharch ke saath milkar ek hi jagah dikhe; isliye pehle ki tarah rail ka alag budget pesh karna band ho gaya tatha rail ke liye raashi aam budget ke andar hi tay hone lagi. Rail budget poora khatam karna, rail ko niji haath dena tatha sab ke liye muft kiraya wale vikalp is badlav ka sahi roop nahi batate, isliye inmein se koi is badlav ke saath nahi.Exam point: 2017 mein rail budget kendra ke budget mein mila diya gaya - isse rail ke paise ka ek jagah hisaab hone laga.

qe: Which committee recommended the merger of the Rail Budget with the Union Budget?
qh: किस समिति ने रेल बजट को केंद्रीय बजट में मिलाने की सिफारिश की थी?
e: Rail budget ko kendra ke budget mein milane ki salah Bibek Debroy samiti ne di thi, isliye pehla vikalp sahi samiti hai. Yah samiti isliye banayi gayi thi ki rail ke badhte kharch tatha kam aay ka hal nikale; isliye usne rail ke kaam ko badalne tatha budget ko aam budget ke saath jodne ki salah di, jisse rail ke liye paisa tay karne ka rasta aasan hua. Vijay Kelkar, Narasimham tatha Urjit Patel samitiyan anya vishyon par kaam ke liye jaani jaati hain, isliye inmein se koi yahan sateek nahi hai.Exam point: rail budget milane ki salah Bibek Debroy samiti ne di - yahi sudhar ka pehla kadam tha.

qe: What does 'Charged Expenditure' mean in the Indian Budget?
qh: भारतीय बजट में 'भारित व्यय' (Charged Expenditure) का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Loans taken from the local public
Expenditure on mobile charges for ministers
Expenditure that is not subject to voting in Parliament (e.g., salaries of the President, Judges)
e: Charged Expenditure yaani charged vyay wo kharch hota hai jise sansad mein vote ke bina hi sanchit nidhi se nikala ja sakta hai, isliye chauthe vikalp wala arth sahi hai. Yah vyavastha isliye ki gayi ki nyayadhish, rashtrapati tatha CAG jaise swatantra padon ki suvidha par vidhayak ke mann se kaat na kar sake; isliye unke vetan tatha anya kharch ko bina charcha tay kiya jaata hai, halaanki baaki samanya kharch par sansad vote karke manzuri deti hai. Janta se liya karz, mantriyon ke mobile ka kharch tatha gair-jaruri kharch wale vikalp is shabd ke sahi nahi hain, isliye inmein se koi is shreni ke nahi hain.Exam point: charged vyay bina voting ke chukaya jaata hai - yahi samvidhan ne swatantra padon ke liye rakha hai.

qe: Why was the date of the Union Budget presentation moved from the last day of February to February 1st?
qh: केंद्रीय बजट पेश करने की तारीख फरवरी के आखिरी दिन से हटाकर 1 फरवरी क्यों कर दी गई?
o: To complete the legislative process before the start of the new financial year on April 1st
To match with the international holidays
Because the Finance Minister wanted a holiday
To avoid the heat of March
e: Budget ki tareekh February ke aakhri din se badalkar pehli February se isliye ki gayi ki naye vittiya varsh ek April se pehle saari manzuri ho jaye, isliye pehla vikalp sahi kaaran hai. Is badlav ke peeche yah wajah thi ki pehle budget ko manzuri milte-milte vittiya varsh shuru ho jaata tha tatha kharch ke liye aage ki tareekh ka intezaar karna padta tha; isliye ek mahina pehle budget aane se samay bachta hai tatha naye kaam April se hi shuru ho paate hain. Videshi chhuttiyon se mel, mantri ki chhutti tatha March ki garmi se bachna wale vikalp is badlav ke sahi nahi hain, isliye inmein se koi is kaaran ka nahi.Exam point: ek February ko budget pesh karne ka maksad April se pehle manzuri paana hai - isse kaam samay par shuru hote hain.

qe: What does the term 'Duty Drawback' mean for an exporter?
qh: एक निर्यात के लिए 'ड्यूटी ड्रॉबैक' (Duty Drawback) शब्द का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Refund of customs and excise duties paid on inputs used in the manufacture of exported goods
Paying extra duty to the government
e: Jin kachche maal par kar diya gaya ho aur usse bani cheez niryat ho jaaye, un par lage kar ki wapsi ko duty drawback kehte hain, isliye pehla vikalp sahi matlab hai. Yah wapsi isliye hoti hai ki bharat ka maal videshi bazaar mein mahanga na ho; isliye niryatkar ko diya gaya kar wapas karke uski laagat ghatayi jaati hai, jisse niryat badhe tatha usme kharab nahi ho. Videshi mudra se hone wale labh par kar, sarkar ko jyada kar dena tatha der se niryat par jurmana wale vikalp is shabd ka sahi matlab nahi dete, isliye inmein se koi aisa matlab nahi deta.Exam point: duty drawback niryat ke kachche maal par lage kar ki wapsi hai - isse bharat ka maal bahar sasta padta hai.

qe: What is 'Fiscal Deficit' and how is it related to 'Current Account Deficit' in the 'Twin Deficit' concept?
qh: 'राजकोषीय घाटा' क्या है और 'ट्विन डेफिसिट' (Twin Deficit) अवधारणा में यह करंट अकाउंट घाटे से कैसे संबंधित है?
o: When both the government's budget deficit and the country's trade deficit are high
When two different currencies have the same value
When a country has double the amount of gold
When the bank interest rate is doubled
e: Jab sarkar ka budget ghata tatha desh ka vyapar ghata dono ek saath badhein, ushe twin deficit kehte hain, isliye pehla vikalp sahi joda hai. Dono isliye jud jaate hain ki sarkar ka zyada kharch aayat badhata hai tatha karz lene ki zarurat se bahar se paisa aata hai; isliye vyapar ghata badhne ka matlab yah bhi hai ki desh bahar se zyada maal kharid raha hai, tatha ise poora karne ke liye videshi punji par nirbharta badhti hai. Do mudraon ka ek hi keemat, sone ka dugna bhandar tatha byaj dar ka dugna hona wale vikalp is shabd ke asli roop se door hain, isliye inmein se koi is jode ka nahi hai.Exam point: twin deficit budget ghate tatha vyapar ghate ka joda hai - dono ek saath badhein to sankat gadgada hai.

qe: What is a 'Tobin Tax' primarily designed to achieve?
qh: 'टोबिन टैक्स' (Tobin Tax) मुख्य रूप से क्या प्राप्त करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है?
o: To fund the education of poor children
To discourage short-term speculative capital flows and reduce currency volatility
To increase the tax on gold imports
e: Tobin tax chhote samay ke sooda-baaji wale paise ke aane-jaane par lagta hai tatha mudra ki halchal kam karne ke liye banaya gaya tha, isliye teesra vikalp sahi maksad hai. Yah kar isliye sujhaya gaya ki ek desh se doosre desh mein pal bhar mein uda jaane wale paison se chhoti arthavyavastha par bura asar padta hai; isliye har badle hue paise par chhota shulk lagane se aisi tez bhag-daud kuch tham jaati hai, halaanki ise lagu karna aasan nahi hota. Kheti ki aay par kar, gareeb bachon ki padhai ka kosh tatha sona aayat par kar wale vikalp is shabd ke sahi kaam nahi hain, isliye inmein se koi is maksad ka nahi.Exam point: Tobin tax mudra ke sooda-baaji wale aane-jaane par lagta hai - isse mudra ki asamanjas ghatti hai.

qe: What constitutes 'External Debt' for a country like India?
qh: भारत जैसे देश के लिए 'बाह्य ऋण' (External Debt) में क्या शामिल होता है?
o: The total value of gold in Indian temples
All types of foreign currency liabilities of the Central Govt, Indian companies, and residents
Only the loans taken by the common public from local banks
Only the taxes paid by NRIs
e: Desh ke kendra sarkar, companyon tatha nivasiyon par videshi mudra mein bane saare dayitv bahya karz yaani External Debt mein ginte hain, isliye doosra vikalp sahi khulaasa hai. Yah karz isliye alag dekha jaata hai ki ise videshi mudra mein chukana padta hai; isliye jab rupee ki keemat gire tatha desh ki aay kam ho, tab yah bojh bhaari pad jaata hai, isliye ise jeeDiPi ke saath jodkar dekha jaata hai. Mandiron ke sone ki keemat, aam janta ke bankon se liye karz tatha NRI ke kar wale vikalp is shabd ke sahi hisse nahi hain, isliye inmein se koi is soochi mein nahi hai.Exam point: bahya karz videshi mudra ke saare dayitv hote hain - ismein sarkar, company tatha log tino shaamil hain.

qe: What does the term 'Debt Servicing' primarily refer to in eco?
qh: अर्थशास्त्र में 'ऋण सेवा' (Debt Servicing) शब्द का प्राथमिक अर्थ क्या है?
o: Providing free banking services to people
Payment of the principal amount along with interest on the borrowed funds
Selling government assets to pay off debt
Increasing the tax rate for everyone
e: Karz liya gaya asli paisa tatha uspar ka byaj chukane ko hi karz seva yaani Debt Servicing kehte hain, isliye doosra vikalp sahi arth hai. Yah bhugtan isliye sabse pehle dekha jaata hai ki saal ki aay ka kitna hissa pehle se bandha hua hai; isliye byaj tatha asli rakam chukane ke baad hi naye kaam ke liye paisa bachta hai, tatha isi karan uchh karz wale desh ke vikas par asar padta hai. Muft banking suvidha, karz chukane ke liye sampatti bechna tatha sab par kar badhana wale vikalp is shabd ka sahi arth nahi batate, isliye inmein se koi yahan theek nahi thehrta.Exam point: karz seva mein asli rakam tatha byaj dono chukana padta hai - isse sarkar ke haath mein kam paisa bachta hai.

qe: The 'External Debt to GDP Ratio' is an important indicator of:
qh: 'बाह्य ऋण-जीडीपी अनुपात' किसका एक महत्वपूर्ण संकेतक है?
o: The amount of rainfall in a year
The total number of citizens in a country
The economic sustainability and sensitivity of a country's external debt
The gold reserves of a nation
e: Bahya karz tatha jeeDiPi ka anupat batata hai ki desh par kitna videshi bojh hai tatha ushe sanbhalna kitna mushkil hai, isliye teesra vikalp sahi sanket hai. Yah anupat isliye ahem hai ki karz ki rakam jitni bhi ho, uski tulna desh ki kul aay se karni padti hai; isliye anupat ghatne ka matlab hai aay karz se tez badh rahi hai, tatha ye anupat badhne par videshi niveshkar tatha ritkar desh par bharosa karna kam kar dete hain. Baarish ki maatra, nagrikon ki sankhya tatha sone ka bhandar wale vikalp is anupat se juda nahi hai, isliye inmein se koi is taraf nahi dekhta.Exam point: bahya karz-jiDiPi anupat desh ke bahari bojh tatha ushe sanbhalne ki kshamta dikhata hai - yahi ritkar ki najar ka aaina hai.

qe: What characterizes India's 'Public Debt' compared to many other developing nations?
qh: कई अन्य विकासशील देशों की तुलना में भारत के 'सार्वजनिक ऋण' की क्या विशेषता है?
o: A large majority (around 90%) is internal debt, owed to domestic residents and institutions
Most of it is owed to foreign countries
India only owes money in gold
e: Bharat ka bahut bada hissa karib nabbe pratishat sarvajanik karz desh ke andar hi liya gaya hai, isliye pehla vikalp sahi hai. Yah baat isliye tasalli wali hai ki yah karz apne hi logon tatha sansthaon ka hai tatha rupee mein chukaya jaata hai; isliye videshi mudra ki keemat badalne ka seedha jokhim kam rehta hai, aur isi karan bharat ka karz sankat mein ek dum doobne ka khatra anya kamzor deshon se kam hota hai. Shunya karz, zyadatar videshi karz tatha keval sone mein karz wale vikalp asli aakdon se mel nahi khaate, isliye ye teeno asli ganit se hatkar banaye gaye hain. Exam point: bharat ka sarvajanik karz adhiktar andaruni hai - isliye muda ki keemat ka jokhim kam padta hai.

qe: Why is 'Internal Debt' considered safer than 'External Debt' for a government?
qh: सरकार के लिए 'आंतरिक ऋण' को 'बाह्य ऋण' से अधिक सुरक्षित क्यों माना जाता है?
o: Because internal debt doesn't need to be repaid
Because it does not involve foreign exchange risk and the government can print home currency to manage it
Because local people don't ask for interest
Because only farmers give internal debt
e: Antarik karz bahya karz se isliye zyada surakshit maana jaata hai ki usmein videshi mudra ka jokhim nahi hota tatha apni mudra chhapne ki shakti sarkar ke paas hoti hai, isliye doosra vikalp sahi hai. Yah suraksha isliye khaas hai ki bahya karz videshi mudra mein chukana padta hai, tatha desh ki mudra girne par wahi karz bhaari ho jaata hai; isliye andar ke karz mein aisa koi jokhim nahi hota tatha bajat ki dikkat aane par sarkar asaani se bandobast kar leti hai. Bina bhugtan wala karz, bina byaj wala karz tatha keval kisaanon se karz wale vikalp is tark se door hain, isliye ye teeno tark ki jaanch mein fail ho jaate hain. Exam point: andaruni karz ka sauda apni mudra mein hota hai - yahi ushe bahya karz se zyada surakshit banata hai.

qe: What happens if a country uses its external borrowings for 'Consumption' instead of 'Investment'?
qh: यदि कोई देश अपने बाह्य उधार का उपयोग 'निवेश' के बजाय 'उपभोग' के लिए करता है तो क्या होता है?
o: The debt is automatically canceled by the World Bank
The country becomes very rich quickly
It creates a future burden as the debt doesn't generate income to pay back the interest
e: Yadi karz lekar banaye gaye kaam se aay na badhe tatha wo paisa roz ke kharch mein chala jaye, to karz ka bojh aage badhta hai, isliye chauthe vikalp ki baat sahi hai. Iska kaaran yah hai ki udhar ka paisa to bhugtan maangta hai par usse koi naya kaam ya paisa paida nahi hota; isliye byaj chukane ke liye aage aa kar tatha kharch katane padte hain, tatha isi karan karz pahad ban jaata hai. Shunya mehngai, World Bank dwara karz maaf tatha turant ameeri wale vikalp is salah se taluk nahi rakhte, isliye ye teeno is niyam ke viprit hain. Exam point: karz upbhog par lagana aage ka bojh banata hai - isliye karz nivesh par lagana zyada behtar hai.

qe: What is the role of the 'GST Network' (GSTN)?
qh: 'जीएसटी नेटवर्क' (GSTN) की क्या भूमिका है?
o: To provide the IT infrastructure for registration and returns
e: GSTN ka asli kaam panjikaran, riport tatha return bharne ke liye IT sahara dena hai, isliye doosra vikalp sahi hai. Yah cholha isliye banaya gaya ki kar lene wale har vyakti ka ekar ek hi jagah hisaab ho; isliye karobar apne darj aakdon ke saath poore desh mein kahin bhi kar chuka sakta hai, tatha kendra tatha rajya dono ko ek hi soochi se ginti milti hai. Raksha budget sambhalna, kar choron ko pakadna tatha kar ki dar tay karna wale vikalp GSTN ke kaam se alag hain, isliye ye teeno GSTN ke kaam ke nahi hain. Exam point: GSTN GST ka IT dhaancha hai - isse panjikaran tatha return bharne ka kaam chalta hai.

qe: Which indicator should be closely monitored to prevent a Balance of Payments crisis?
qh: भुगतान संतुलन संकट को रोकने के लिए किस संकेतक की बारीकी से निगरानी की जानी चाहिए?
o: Number of holidays in a year
Amount of rainfall in a decade
Current Account Deficit (CAD) and Debt Service Ratio
e: Bhugtan santulan ka sankat rokne ke liye karant khata ghata tatha karz seva anupat par nigrani rakhi jaati hai, isliye teesra vikalp sahi hai. Ye dono isliye pehle dekhe jaate hain ki aayat badhne tatha bahar se karz badhne par hi sankat ka bij padta hai; isliye jab ghata seema se upar jaye ya karz chukane ka bojh aay ke muqable badhe, to samay rahte sudhar ke kadam uthane padte hain. Chhuttiyoon ki ginti, barsaat ki maatra tatha aabadi ki badhotri wale vikalp is nigrani se door hain, isliye ye teeno is nigrani se koi taalluk nahi rakhte. Exam point: karant khata ghata tatha karz seva anupat sankat ke pehle ke ishare hain - inhe dekhte rehna zaroori hai.

qe: What is the primary objective of 'Fiscal Stimulus' packages provided by governments during a recession?
qh: मंदी के दौरान सरकारों द्वारा प्रदान किए जाने वाले 'राजकोषीय प्रोत्साहन' (Fiscal Stimulus) पैकेजों का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: To reduce the salaries of employees
To boost aggregate demand and economic activity through increased government spending or tax cuts
To close down all private companies
To stop the import of petroleum
e: Mandi ke samay diye jaane wale rajkoshiya protsahan yaani Fiscal Stimulus ka maksad khapat tatha aarthik harkat badhana hai, isliye doosra vikalp sahi hai. Yah haathiyar isliye apnaya jaata hai ki mandi mein karobar tatha log kam kharch karne lagte hain; isliye sarkar apne kharch badha kar ya kar mein riayat de kar logon ke haath mein paisa laati hai, jisse dukaan tatha karkhane chalu rehte hain tatha naukariyan bachi rehti hain. Karmchariyon ki tankha ghatana, niji companyon ko band karna tatha tel aayat rokna wale vikalp is maksad ke viprit hain, isliye ye teeno yahan ghalat thaharte hain. Exam point: rajkoshiya protsahan khapat badha kar mandi se bahar nikalne ka upay hai - isse aarthik harkat tez hoti hai.

qe: What is the goal of 'Fiscal Consolidation' as mentioned in the text?
qh: पाठ में बताए अनुसार 'राजकोषीय सुदृढ़ीकरण' (Fiscal Consolidation) का लक्ष्य क्या है?
o: Increasing the government's borrowing to infinity
Reducing the fiscal deficit to a sustainable level (e.g., 3% of GDP)
e: Rajkoshiya sudridhikaran yaani Fiscal Consolidation ka lakshya ghate ko sahi tatha tike hue star par laana hai, isliye teesra vikalp sahi hai. Yah koshish isliye ki jaati hai ki har saal bada ghata sarkar ko karz lekar poora karna padta hai tatha byaj ka bojh aane wali peedhi par aata hai; isliye kar vasooli badha kar tatha faltu kharch ghatakar ise jeeDiPi ke teen pratishat jaise star tak laane ki koshish hoti hai. Sab ko muft bijli, bepanah karz badhana tatha saara kharch rokna wale vikalp is lakshya ke nahi hain, isliye ye teeno is koshish ke raaste nahi hain. Exam point: rajkoshiya sudridhikaran ghate ko sahi star tak laane ki koshish hai - isse aage aarthik sthirta milti hai.
